locator.section: 8.x Proton-bound complexes / hydrogen rearrangement (rH) in even-electron ions

evidence.curator_note: EXPERIMENTAL CONTEXT: this C2H5+ + O=CH2 channel is CROSSED OUT on eq 8.14 (X through the lower arrow from the proton-bound complex): the MI spectrum of C2H5O+=CH2 shows NO C2H5+. Encoded with support_type=contradicted and peak status=rejected. adduct is not [M]+.: the precursor is the even-electron m/z 59 fragment ion. 0 electron-pushing arcs drawn. Equation 8.14, REJECTED (lower) branch: the reaction arrow leading to C2H5+ + O=CH2 is drawn CROSSED OUT (a large X over the arrow). McLafferty rejects this direct inductive (i) C-O cleavage of C2H5-O+=CH2 to the ethyl cation C2H5+ (m/z 29) plus neutral formaldehyde; the text confirms the MI spectrum of C2H5O=CH2+ 'shows no C2H5+'. Encoded here only to record the disfavored path (support_type contradicted, peak status rejected). Book draws 0 electron-pushing arcs; the single encoded move is reconstructed for electron balance (not drawn on the page): move <1> takes the C5-O8 bonding pair fully onto O8, neutralising the oxocarbenium O+ to a formaldehyde carbonyl oxygen and expelling C5 as the ethyl cation (charge migration to carbon). Closed-shell, even-electron heterolysis.

No MOD rule encodes this rejected channel. The three by_equation['8.14'] rules (IMS_8_14_1, IMS_8_14_1b, IMS_8_14_2) all pertain to the favored rH path / proton-bound complex (see IMS8-EQ8.14a), none to the direct C-O inductive cleavage giving C2H5+ + O=CH2. Consistent with the book crossing this path out, there is nothing to cross-link here.

observed_mz 29.0380 is the curator-computed monoisotopic m/z of C2H5+ (electron-mass corrected). status 'rejected': the book explicitly crosses out this channel and states no C2H5+ is observed in the MI spectrum. No intensity printed; relative_intensity omitted.
